linkedin.text:
🚨 Your blog drafts are shipping with broken links, missing schema, and zero AI citation readiness.

Most writers hit publish and hope the SEO gods smile. But Google wants usefulness signals, and AI systems want source-ready structure.

That's why claude-blog exists: a Claude Code skill suite that writes, scores, and ships articles under a 5-gate delivery contract.

✅ Every draft must hit 90+ on a 100-point rubric or it auto-retries up to 3 times
✅ You get markdown, HTML, PDF, hero image, screenshots, schema, and preflight report in one artifact folder
✅ 32 skill directories, 30 user-facing commands, 5 specialized agents, and 250+ passing tests

The orchestrator routes /blog write through sub-skills for strategy, briefs, outlines, rewrites, multilingual, topic clusters, and content decay detection. You never see a draft until format, visuals, content, and asset integrity all pass.

⭐ 1,908 stars and MIT-licensed.

Search GitHub for "AgriciDaniel/claude-blog" and ship posts that actually rank.

What's the last SEO task you automated that actually saved you hours?
